description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing claim expense types within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expense types, along with associated validation rules and documentation annotations for OpenAPI/Swagger.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing claim expense types, including CRUD operations, validation, and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all expense types with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new expense type.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific expense type by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing expense type by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete one or more expense types by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method query parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting expense types.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an expense type.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Configures options to ignore certain values when checking for unique 'name'.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Populates an ExpenseType entity with data from request parameters.
